mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for implementing GEO for Help Articles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Implementation typically begins with a comprehensive audit of existing help content and keyword research to identify geographically relevant terms. Next, articles are optimized by strategically integrating these local keywords, location-specific examples, and relevant schema markup. This is followed by content creation for any identified gaps. Finally, ongoing monitoring and analysis are crucial to track performance, refine strategies, and ensure continued local search effectiveness. Our team manages this entire process.
